audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Tryndamere, Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser — a Mordekaiser stomp from level 3 to late, in a matchup Tryndamere wins 54.93% over 1622 games, and it contradicted the page's own prose from first item on.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror set Level 1 Skill, Levels 2-3 Mordekaiser, Levels 4-5 onward Tryndamere. Mordekaiser has no dash; Spinning Slash on 12/11/10/9/8s means Tryndamere picks every trade once E is up and rules the side lane.
audit.corrected: Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere with ratings 5,4,3,6,6,6,7. Both layers proposed as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Mordekaiser's spike and first item as his too; Realm of Death's cooldown was never given.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s — the longest cooldown in the lane and the whole reason the flip holds. Undying Rage is 120/100/80s and costs nothing, so there is no resource to pressure, only that timer.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and first item reassigned to Tryndamere with both real cooldowns stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Darkness Rise 'his passive Indestructible shield', merging his passive and his W, and claimed lifesteal is 'useless' inside Realm of Death.
audit.why: Darkness Rise (P) is the damage aura that arms after 3 attacks or spells; Indestructible (W) is the separate 12/11/10/9/8s store-and-heal shield fed by damage he deals AND takes. Riot's text gives no lifesteal suppression inside the realm — the real problem is that he steals a portion of your stats and can wait out Undying Rage's 5 seconds.
audit.corrected: Passive and W separated in early/spikes; the realm line rewritten around stat theft and the timed-out ult instead of a lifesteal claim.

audit.why: missingInteractions flags 'needs-antiheal'. Indestructible converts your chip into his shield and heal, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades — report[8] already lists Executioner's Calling early, and phases[2].why now names the reason.

edits.before: Spin up fury on the wave before contesting anything. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Trade around Darkness Rise: three attacks or spells and his aura ramps, so step out after two and spin your fury back up on the wave.

edits.before: E lets you spin in and out of exchanges on your terms. Only take the trade when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: Obliterate is up on 8s and hits harder on a lone target — stay inside the minions until Spinning Slash arrives at 3.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Mordekaiser must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Death's Grasp pulls you into Obliterate, and Indestructible banks your chip into his shield — Executioner's Calling early.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Realm of Death's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: It flips here: he owns no dash, so Spinning Slash on 12/11/10/9/8s lets you pick every trade and leave before Obliterate lands.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mordekaiser's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Realm of Death drags you 1v1 and steals a share of your stats, but Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — bank full fury before 6 so Bloodlust lands as it ends.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Realm of Death's cooldown.
edits.after: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights while Realm of Death sits on its 140/120/100s cooldown.

edits.before: Level 1 favours you — a clunky pre-combo Morde loses the Q-reset trade before his shield stacks.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — Morde is clunky pre-combo, but Darkness Rise punishes you for standing in it.

edits.before: Level 2 is even as his Q-E combo starts forming and threatens a real trade.
edits.after: Level 2 is his — Obliterate at 675 range plus Death's Grasp is a real trade.

edits.before: Level 3 stays a skill window between his shielded poke and your trade discipline.
edits.after: Level 3 stays his — Indestructible banks your chip into a shield he heals off.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 favour Mordekaiser — his Q-E pull with full passive shield wins extended trades.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 flip to you — Spinning Slash on 12-8s beats a Morde with no dash at all.

edits.before: Level 6 stays his: R Realm of Death isolates you where lifesteal and escape don't save you.
edits.after: Level 6 is yours: Undying Rage outlasts the realm and Bloodlust refills you as it drops.

edits.before: At first item you flip it — surviving his R on Undying Rage lets your Q out-sustain his DoT.
edits.after: At first item you keep it — surviving R on Undying Rage lets Bloodlust out-heal his aura.

edits.before: His R Realm of Death is the danger — inside his death realm your lifesteal and escape are useless, and R Undying Rage's ghost window can be timed out. Never fight him at low health at 6.
edits.after: His R Realm of Death is the danger — it drags you 1v1, steals a share of your stats, and Undying Rage's 5 seconds can be timed out. Enter with full fury so Bloodlust lands the instant R ends.

edits.before: Level 1 favours you — Morde is slow and clunky before his combo comes online, so trade with Q Bloodlust resets and shove him off the wave. Deny his passive Indestructible shield from stacking early.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — Morde is clunky before his combo, so trade in short bursts and shove. Darkness Rise (P) needs three hits to arm, and every point of chip you deal banks into his Indestructible (W) shield.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are Mordekaiser's window: his Q Obliterate into E Death's Grasp pull with a full passive shield wins extended trades, and at 6 his R Realm of Death isolates you where lifesteal and escape don't save you. Sidestep the Q, avoid the E pull, and never fight him low at 6.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 are Mordekaiser's window: Obliterate (Q) at 675 range hits harder on a lone target and Death's Grasp (E) pulls you into it. From 4 it flips — he has no dash, so Spinning Slash on 12/11/10/9/8s lets you take the trade and leave before his combo returns.

notes: The packet's levelChart (Tryndamere, Skill, Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Tryndamere, Tryndamere) disagrees with the already-audited mirror; per the mirror rule I followed the mirror. Flag misfire noted, not written: the kit tags Obliterate (Q) with 'grounding — shuts off enemy dashes', but Riot's description is only 'smashes the ground... damage is increased when hitting a single enemy'. Per the flag-versus-description rule I made no grounding claim about Spinning Slash being shut off; if that grounding is real it would materially change the levels 4-5 flip, so it is listed in unverified.
